title: Espaces stratifiés et voisinages côniques (ou : déploiement des espaces stratifiés) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: Notational clash: I denotes both the index set of the family (J ⊂ I) and the interval [0,1] in I^J. The text says 'J ⊂ I, I fini'; finiteness is of the family, which is harmless.
In the induced map p_0 the source should be Ẋ_0 (boundary part), not X_0 as transcribed.

The equivalence 'E_J cylindrical in each E_{B_j}' is only sketched; as stated, mutual compatibility of homotheties for different j (commutation) is implicit in the product form, not separately argued. No genuine mathematical error.

ideas.what: Collared map: p|Ẋ_0×I = p_0 × id_I with Ẋ_0 = p^{-1}(Y_0)
ideas.modern_name: map compatible with collars / collared morphism

ideas.what: Transversal family of cylindrical neighbourhoods: E_J ≃ B_J × I^J with homothety of E_{B_j} acting on the j-th coordinate
ideas.modern_name: compatible system of collars on a manifold with corners / ⟨n⟩-manifold structure; commuting tubular data
ideas.usually_credited_to: Cerf and Douady (1961, variétés à bord anguleux), Jänich (1968), Laures (2000); in stratified setting Mather control data (1970), Verona (1984)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme §5 mentions 'déploiement' of stratified structures but not these conditions

ideas.what: Transversality of a corner-collar system with a conical neighbourhood (T, Ṫ, Y): products T_J × I^J, Ṫ_J × I^J, Y_J × I^J
ideas.modern_name: control-data compatibility between link/tube data and corner collars (resolution of Thom–Mather spaces into manifolds with fibred corners)

deep.surprise_reason: A careful but standard formulation of corner-compatible collars and their compatibility with conical (link) neighbourhoods, a step in Grothendieck's 'déploiement' programme. This matches later work by Verona, Albin–Melrose and Ayala–Francis–Tanaka on resolving stratified spaces into manifolds with corners. Historically nice as evidence of Grothendieck's tame-topology programme, but nothing here is absent from the literature.
transcription_corrections: 'voisinages cylindriques des strates B_i de X' should read 'des parties B_i de X'.
'p_0 : X_0 → Y_0' should be 'p_0 : Ẋ_0 → Y_0'.

The line 'est transversale ... de manière compatible ...' is a left-margin insertion meaning: 'est transversale: E_J ≃ B_J × I^J, de manière compatible aux homothéties λ_{E_j}, ... Ḃ_J = ∩_{i∈J} Ė_j ...'. The main text continues 'à celle de B_J × I^J, l'homothétie de E_j (pour j ∈ J) induisant ...'.
Bottom-left margin 'i.e. dans E_J ≃ B_J × I' should be 'i.e. dans E_J ≃ B_J × I^J'.
Heading word above crossed-out 'Compatibilité' is 'Transversalité'; 'transversaux' replaces 'compatibles' in the definition with T.
